title: Release publish is gated on a manual npm-publish environment approval; v1.34.0 was tagged but never published
observation: Observed 2026-09-14. release.yml's publish job runs in the GitHub environment `npm-publish`, which required a reviewer approval (davesheffer, rule present since 2026-07-23). Previous releases passed only because the releasing agent session approved through the API (v1.32.8, v1.33.0). On 2026-09-14 that call was refused by the host permission gate: the v1.34.0 run sat in `waiting` for two hours; npm latest stayed 1.33.0 while docs announced 1.34.0. v1.35.0 was approved manually on David's instruction. RESOLVED 2026-09-15: the required-reviewers rule was removed from the environment (PUT reviewers [] -> protection_rules []); the environment still exists under the same name, which is all npm trusted publishing needs, so tag pushes publish unattended. Runbook rb_cut_release_01 step 9 rewritten accordingly (private overlay commit ca26883). The stale 1.34.0 deployment was rejected so it could not publish after 1.35.0; CHANGELOG notes 1.34.0 as superseded before publication.
